kimi.failure_policy: Native failed/blame values and nulls retained unchanged; free-text reason omitted entirely; full originals remain local. No failures become negatives.
kimi.derivation_policy: derived_*_count is exact native list length, null stays null and absent stays absent. derived_n_pairs_<outcome> is the native integer dict value, not a new measurement. Dict nullness is explicit; missing outcome keys stay missing.
kimi.row_hash_policy: SHA-256 of each exact source JSONL row including its original newline, in unchanged row order. Hashes disclose no raw payload.

bcb_full.failure_policy: Original failed/blame flags and native eligibility categories retained unchanged. Free-text reasons and private exclusion/request/accounting evidence omitted; full original records stay local. No failure becomes zero.
bcb_full.derivation_policy: V1 list-length and outcome-count rules apply. Additional derived_*_count fields are exact list lengths with null/missing distinctions retained. derived_qualification_* preserves only allowlisted native booleans/integers/nulls; provider_filter_exclusion_recorded records only presence of its original evidence dictionary, never request/reply/accounting contents.
bcb_full.row_hash_policy: SHA-256 of each exact source JSONL row including original newline, unchanged row order.
